text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for traffic calming, specifically speed humps on Neville Park Boulevard, between Queen Street East and its northern terminus, to address residents' concerns regarding vehicle speeds. Our assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the traffic calming policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, traffic calming should not be installed on the subject section of Neville Park Boulevard.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. deleted the polling requirement and approve the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Neville Park Boulevard, between Queen Street East and its northern terminus; and 2. directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Neville Park Boulevard, between Queen Street East and its northern terminus, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the copy of Drawing No.421G-3073, dated June 2018, attached to the report (June 7, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
